description: Two distinct flagged occurrences over one projected span each contribute weight (engine §7.10).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution leftmost-longest(span), late(elision)
%elision-only
%rule text (w ≻ missing) | d | c
%rule w (X [+T]) | ([+U] X)
%counts-as span
%rule missing (M N)
%rule d (X T)
%counts-as span
%rule c (inner T)
%counts-as span
%rule inner X
%counts-as span
